name: kelly-skills
description: Dev tooling (Biome lint/format + typecheck) for the skills repo.

scripts.test:app-skills: npm run test:app-skills:oss && npm run test:app-skills:cloud
scripts.test:app-skills:oss: npm run test:app-skills:oss:kelly-invest-stock && npm run test:app-skills:oss:kelly-email && npm run test:app-skills:oss:kelly-crm && npm run test:app-skills:oss:kelly-agent-builder && npm run test:app-skills:oss:kelly-beauty-intel
scripts.test:app-skills:cloud: npm run test:app-skills:cloud:kelly-invest-stock && npm run test:app-skills:cloud:kelly-email && npm run test:app-skills:cloud:kelly-crm && npm run test:app-skills:cloud:kelly-agent-builder && npm run test:app-skills:cloud:kelly-beauty-intel
scripts.test:app-skills:oss:kelly-email: pnpm --dir skills/kelly-email/app check && node --test tests/app-skills/kelly-email/*.test.mjs && python3 tests/app-skills/kelly-email/ui_test.py
scripts.test:app-skills:oss:kelly-crm: pnpm --dir skills/kelly-crm/app check && node --test tests/app-skills/kelly-crm/*.test.mjs && python3 tests/app-skills/kelly-crm/ui_test.py
